"""Write 人 as two continuous lengthwise brush strokes, with pressure modulation."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.interpolate import PchipInterpolator
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
OUT=Path('/app/output')

def generate(nodes, speed=.005):
    s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json')
    s.reset();s.record_start();p=s.primitives()
    def move(xyz,speed=.04,settle=10):
        r=p['move_tip'](xyz,speed=speed,settle=settle)
        if r['ik_failures']: print('IK failures',r,flush=True)
    def coord(x,y,depth):
        wx,wy=s.geo.px_to_world(x,y)
        return np.array([wx,wy,.02-depth/1000])
    for k,a in enumerate(nodes):
        move([-.1,.15,.065])
        move([-.1,.15,.024],.025,15)
        move([-.1,.15,.065])
        direction=a[1,:2]-a[0,:2]; direction/=np.linalg.norm(direction)
        pre=a[0,:2]-direction*15
        move(coord(*pre,-15))
        move(coord(*pre,-.8),.015,10)
        move(coord(*a[0,:2],-.3),.008,20)
        move(coord(*a[0,:2],a[0,2]),.004,10)
        tt=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(a[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]
        length=tt[-1]*s.geo.px_m
        tt/=tt[-1]
        n=int(np.ceil(length/(speed/20)))
        path=PchipInterpolator(tt,a,axis=0)(np.linspace(0,1,n+1))
        for x,y,depth in path[1:]:
            q,ok,err=s.ik(coord(x,y,depth))
            if not ok: raise RuntimeError(('IK failure',err))
            s.step(q)
        p['hold'](15)
        move(coord(*a[-1,:2],-2),.004,10)
        move(coord(*a[-1,:2],-20),.03,10)
        print('stroke',k,'steps',s.n_steps,'tip',s.tip_pose()[0],flush=True)
    actions=s.record_stop()
    s.save_trajectory(actions,OUT/'trajectory.npz')
    Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(OUT/'canvas.png')
    samples=[z['samples'] for z in s.strokes() if z['sheet']=='main' and z['inked']]
    np.savez(OUT/'samples.npz',**{f'stroke_{k}':z for k,z in enumerate(samples)})
    print('actions',len(actions),flush=True)
    status=s.status()
    (OUT/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status,indent=2))
    print(json.dumps(status,indent=2),flush=True)
    return s

if __name__=='__main__':
    nodes=np.load(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else OUT/'nodes.npy')
    generate(nodes)
